scientific_interpretation: Controlled fault injection benchmarks transit interventions (F1-F4). On natural multi-hop failures, the vast majority are generator reasoning errors (REASONING_ERROR) where evidence was retrieved, but the extractive generator failed multi-hop synthesis. Diagnostics designed for transit faults predict F0 because retrieval scores and lexical overlap are nominal, demonstrating that transit diagnostics do not transfer to reasoning-dominated natural failures without dedicated generation reasoning judges.
